headline: Alligator Bioscience Shares Surge After Securing Financing Through 2027
summary: Research company Alligator Bioscience announced it has sufficient financial funds to cover operations through the end of 2027, sending its shares soaring nearly 20%.
why: Securing operational funding removes near-term dilution or insolvency risks for clinical-stage biotechnology firms.

impacts.name: Alligator Bioscience
impacts.why: Assurance of financial runway eliminates immediate funding overhang, driving positive equity revaluation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The announcement that the company has sufficient financial resources through late 2027 eliminated near-term solvency concerns, prompting a sharp rally in the stock.
